searches.reason: Develop paired history interventions—recent-window truncation, order shuffling, and removal of coherent recent activity—to measure whether HSTU uses current intent. Compare candidate ranks against unchanged histories, control for history length, and use the final nonpadding position for left-padded sequences. These are sensitivity measurements, not proof of causal user preferences.

searches.reason: Build evidence-aware probes for the reported redundant alternatives and incompatible accessories using only available titles, descriptions, and histories. Investigate extracting explicit connector, format, dimension, and quantity constraints, with abstention when evidence is missing. Separate observed contradictions, suspected redundancy, and insufficient information; do not infer fulfilled needs or willingness to choose from purchases alone.

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostics reliably identify actionable failures in one trained HSTU model per category. Study matched hard-negative probes, scale-independent ranking measures, uncertainty intervals, and controlled corruption tests. Distinguish training diagnostics from the fixed validation HR@10 benchmark, and replace unsupported zero defaults with explicit unavailable results.
